name: Pan-Fried Cajun Chicken Thighs with Zucchini & Carrot Rice Pilaf

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, carrots, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
1 (10 oz) bag shredded carrots
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and small dice zucchini. Add to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes more.
While the veggies are cooking, using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water.
When the veggies are tender, add rice and broth to the pan, stir to combine, and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, cover the pan and reduce heat to low. Cook rice pilaf until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove from heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a plate; sprinkle with Cajun seasoning on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
2 tsp Cajun seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm.
To serve, divide rice pilaf and chicken between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
